_README: TEMPLATE — copy to wbc3_lsa.json and fill in real values before use.
Every row is IGNORED until both verified_by and verified_on are set. That is
deliberate. A wrong number here becomes a fabricated statutory requirement
delivered with an authoritative citation, which is more dangerous than any
retrieval error, because it is indistinguishable from ground truth.
1. Open the published Code at the table named in table_reference.
2. For each row of that table, add one entry below with its exact scope
3. length_min is INCLUSIVE, length_max is EXCLUSIVE. A row covering
'15m and over but under 24m' is length_min 15, length_max 24.
4. Rows must not overlap — the loader warns at startup if they do, because a
vessel matching two rows means the transcription is ambiguous.
5. Set verified_by to the name of the person who checked the values against
the Code, and verified_on to the date they checked (YYYY-MM-DD).
Leave a row's verified fields blank and it simply will not be served. The
system falls back to retrieval and says the table needs visual confirmation.
